core_obligations: Reduce to the case of the cokernel of a map phi : j_{W!}O_W -> F where F is given by the standard cokernel presentation with W in the basis (proof lines 5528-5533).

Interpret phi as a section s of F over W; use surjectivity of the presentation and the enough-objects hypothesis to find a covering {W_k -> W} with W_k in the basis on which s lifts to a section of the finite direct sum (proof lines 5534-5541).

Use quasi-compactness of W and the refinement lemma to choose a finite subset K' with a surjection from the corresponding finite direct sum onto j_{W!}O_W, and exhibit the cokernel in the required standard form, completing the proof up to line 5555.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to killing one standard generator.
Lift the corresponding section along a covering from the basis.
Cut the covering to a finite subfamily using quasi-compactness.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the quasi-compact objects situation the cokernel of a map between modules admitting the standard finite cokernel presentation by direct images j_{U!}O_U along basis members again admits such a presentation. The proof reduces to the cokernel of a map out of a single standard object j_{W!}O_W, whose datum is a section s over W; by the enough-objects hypothesis one chooses a covering of W on which s lifts to a section of the finite direct sum, uses quasi-compactness of W and the refinement lemma to cut the covering to a finite subfamily, and reads off the resulting cokernel presentation (proof lines 5527-5555). H2: the lifting of the section along a covering and the finite cut are the substance, and both steps are written out.
